geometryObservations: ice changes meaning four times: forgiving intro floor, run-up enemies can steal, downhill that carries you past crates, bounded patch whose step stops slides
every hazard debuts alone with a safe place to stand (pillar bank, flat icicle floor, waiting spot before disc 1); reprises remove the pause
the counter inverts on the second instance: icicles #1 stop and wait, icicles #2 slide through at once
hedgehog difficulty comes from placement: long flat after C1 with an Aku crate, then take-off edge, landing pillar, after a sprint
enemies attack momentum, not health: seals on the ice patch spoil the run-up for the closing jump
sliding penguin groups are one problem: spin the leader to bowl the line
normal-course gaps are short (1.5-3 u) and level; difficulty comes from what sits on their edges; running jumps are announced by a ramp or kept in the gem course
height is changed by tools and rides (arrow, elevator, crate stairs, gem platform, bonus drop), each a camera-mode change with a checkpoint
the finale turns crate collection into timing: crate piles sit in disc lanes, the crystal arrow spot is the only rest
the gem course is the same grammar on hard settings: faster smashers, collapsing bridges, floating bounce blocks, Nitro as geometry, one maximum jump
recovery is generous where the lesson is new: float-line misses cost a climb, the S4 ice step stops overshoot, bonus falls end the bonus
the bonus is a staircase of move tests ending in a blast-escape distance under a low ceiling
geometryTransfer: ice run-up with pushers: 15-20 m low-traction strip ending at a 4-crate (4.6 m) gap with 2-3 grunt/charger drifting across; on the board a speedpad at the start so a bumped rider must re-accelerate
crusher on the far bank of a 2-3 crate pit, first alone with a waiting bank; reprise with a second crusher cycling 2-3 m behind so stopping between them fails
disc troughs as pendulum gates swinging across a 3-4 m path every 8-10 m, with a crate pile in one lane (stone rolls only along Z, so it cannot cross the path)
spiker curriculum: >=12 m flat after a checkpoint with a mask crate overhead, then take-off edge, then a 2.5-crate landing pad
penguin bowling lane: three grunts coming down a 4-crate-wide downslope in file
on-foot crumble bridge 7-9 m with Nitro at 0, 4 and 8 m, the middle one hanging at ~1.2 m clearance (slide)
